mainEntity.name: What is a hunting and fishing trip travel insurance plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hunting and fishing trip travel insurance plans help cover your travel investment when traveling to participate in sportsman activities. A hunting and fishing trip often has additional costs like guide fees, equipment rentals, additional baggage fees, or license and tag costs. A travel insurance plan that has coverage for your non-refundable sportsman costs is a smart move. It’s also smart to look for a travel insurance plan with higher baggage coverage, since you’re likely traveling with expensive gear and equipment. Travel Guard’s travel insurance plans can help protect your travel investment, so you have the coverage you need.

mainEntity.name: What does a hunting and fishing trip travel insurance plan cover?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Travel Guard offers customizable travel insurance plans for your hunting and fishing trip.  Look for a plan  that has the coverage and benefit limits you need. Popular plan features include:

- Medical expense coverage

- Adventure Sports Bundle – if you’re planning extreme activities (optional add-on coverage available on certain plans)

- Travel inconvenience benefit – a one-time payment for certain inconveniences you encounter on your trip

- Emergency travel assistance – specialized representatives are available day or night to assist with unexpected travel issues

- Baggage coverage

- Trip cancellation coverage

- Cancel for Any Reason (optional add-on coverage available on certain plans)

mainEntity.name: Do I need a hunting and fishing trip travel insurance plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: For any vacation, it’s smart to cover your travel investment, you’ll want to make sure you have the type of plan you need for your unique trip. Hunting and fishing trips typically have increased costs like travel arrangements, equipment rentals, guide fees, or license and tag costs. With a Travel Guard travel insurance plan, your travel investment can be protected, and you have access to our specially trained representatives for  24-hour travel emergency assistance . Our representatives will work to help you through any unexpected travel mishaps.

mainEntity.name: Which Travel Guard travel insurance plan is best for my hunting and fishing trip?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Travel Guard offers a few options for hunting and fishing trip travel insurance plans to help ensure you have the coverage you need while on your vacation. Our  Deluxe  plan has the highest benefit limits on baggage coverage, which may be the best option depending on what you’re bringing with you. Make sure you also check our optional Adventure Sports Bundle ; you may want that depending on the type of hunting you’re doing. All our plans include comprehensive coverage – flights and hotel, non-refundable excursions and rental cars can be covered with your Travel Guard travel insurance plan.

No matter which Travel Guard insurance plan you choose, you’ll have access to our specially trained representatives for  24/7 emergency travel assistance .

mainEntity.name: Are there per item limits on baggage coverage?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Yes, it’s important to know that on the  Essential  and  Preferred  Travel Guard plans there is a limit of $500 for the first item and $250 for each subsequent item. On the  Deluxe  plan the limit is $1,000 for the first item and $500 for each subsequent item. Take this into consideration when choosing a travel insurance plan for your hunting and fishing trip.

Always be sure to  read your policy details  to make sure you have the coverage you need.

mainEntity.name: Why purchase your hunting and fishing trip travel insurance plan through Travel Guard?

acceptedAnswer.text: Travel Guard is one of the world’s leading travel insurance providers with a network of service centers located in Asia, Europe and the Americas, ensuring the highest quality emergency travel services and medical assistance while you’re traveling. With early purchase benefits and optional add-on coverages, you can customize the plan and coverages you need for your adventure vacation.
